bib.title: Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for Near-Infinite Context

read.skipped: Figures 1, 3 and 5 and the MFU bars of Table 4 are images; their values are not in the text.

question: How can Transformer context length scale with device count without approximating attention or adding communication overhead, given that per-layer outputs no longer fit on one device?
hypothesis: If blockwise attention is permutation-invariant over key-value blocks, rotating KV blocks around a ring of hosts can fully overlap communication with blockwise compute, so context grows linearly with devices at no overhead provided block size c >= FLOPS/bandwidth.
contributions: a memory efficient transformers architecture that allows the context length to scale linearly with the number of devices while maintaining performance, eliminating the memory bottleneck imposed by individual devices
demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments

method.summary: Ring Attention extends Blockwise Parallel Transformers: the sequence is split into one block per host; each host keeps its query block and computes blockwise attention and FFN, while key-value blocks are passed around a ring (send to next host, receive from previous) overlapped with compute via jax.lax.ppermute. Exact attention, same architecture.
method.task: long-context Transformer training (max context length, MFU), in-context RL on ExoRL, and LLaMA-13B finetuning evaluated on line retrieval

datasets.name: ShareGPT conversations
datasets.source: ShareGPT.com public APIs, user-shared ChatGPT conversations
datasets.preprocessing: convert HTML back to markdown and filter out some inappropriate or low-quality samples

datasets.name: ExoRL
datasets.split: Trajectories of length 1000 x 4 (return-state-action-reward); N Trajs 32 or 128
datasets.source: Yarats et al. 2022, collected with unsupervised RL

models.name: LLaMA-architecture models 3B, 7B, 13B, 30B (65B in Table 4)
models.architecture: LLaMA decoder-only Transformer with Ring Attention
models.context: up to 16384K tokens (3B, TPUv4-1024) in the max-context test

models.name: vanilla, memory efficient attention, BPT (memory efficient attention + FFN)

training.batch_size: MFU runs: 2M tokens on 8/32x A100, 4M tokens on TPUv4 (TPUv4-256 in Sec 5.2, TPU in B.2); max-context runs keep total batch tokens n*l the same as the FSDP baseline
training.precision: Sec 4: full precision instead of mixed precision. B.1: TPU matmul in bfloat16 with float32 weight accumulation; GPU all float32.
training.regularisation: full gradient checkpointing on attention and FFN (nothing_saveable policy)
training.hardware: single DGX A100 8 GPUs, 32x A100 80GB, TPUv3-512, TPUv4-1024 (and TPUv4-256 for MFU), TPUv5e-256; finetune on 32x A100 80GB

other.parallelism: FSDP with Jax SPMD; no tensor parallelism in the max-context test
other.finetune_method: following Vicuna and Koala methodologies; hyperparameters not given

other.inference_claim: Appendix C: serving LLaMA 7B on 32x TPUv5e, batch 1, conventional head-sharded serving reaches 256K context from KV cache size; Ring Attention could give 32x; needs B/F >= 2; with 186 GB/s and 196 TFLOPs at assumed 40% MFU, B/F = 2.4. Analytical, not measured.

metrics.name: line retrieval accuracy

results.quote: achieving a total average return of 113.66 compared to the AT with BPT model’s total average return of 111.13
results.note: Single run per task, no variance. BC-10% 36.11, DT 45.51.

results.setup: Table 4, 13B, 32x A100; MFU bars are in a figure and are not in the text
results.quote: Ring Attention enables training large models (7B-65B) on large input context sizes (over 4M) with negligible overheads.

results.quote: the potential context size can be expanded to 16 million

results.setup: batch 1, hidden size 1024, must store each layer output

limits: Authors finetune only to 512K tokens because of cloud budget; the million-token training is measured as max fit, not trained to convergence.
No quality results beyond one line-retrieval plot (no numbers) and a six-task RL benchmark with single runs; no perplexity or downstream long-context benchmark.
Authors concede MFU is expected to be lower than BPT at longer context since self-attention has lower MFU than feedforward; Table 4 gives context sizes only in text (MFU bars in a figure).
Overlap requires block size c >= FLOPS/bandwidth; InfiniBand GPUs need min seq len about 149.5K per host.
Inference claim (32x context on 32x TPUv5e) is analytical, no measurement, assumes 40 percent MFU.
Max-context test uses FSDP with no tensor parallelism and a mix of precision settings across hardware (float32 on GPU, bfloat16 matmul on TPU).
Hyperparameters of finetuning (lr, steps, batch) are not given.
Inconsistencies: text says TPUv4-512 and over 30M tokens but Table 3 shows TPUv4-1024 and max 16384K; Table 4 caption says over 4M but max entry is 2048K.
